assertions.assertion: Agent updates reservation OBUT9V return flights to HAT290 and HAT175 on May 27.
assertions.rationale: The agent never updated the reservation flights. Multiple search_direct_flight tool calls returned empty results, and the agent ultimately transferred the customer to a human agent without making any flight changes.
The agent never processed any payment or assigned a payment method. No payment-related tool calls were made, and the conversation ended with a transfer to a human agent.

assertions.assertion: Agent updates reservation OBUT9V to 2 free baggages.

summary: Agent failed to complete any of the requested actions due to technical difficulties and transferred the customer to a human agent.
